dataset: Pittsburgh Short-Term Rental Census: Lawrenceville and Bloomfield
scope: Official City of Pittsburgh neighborhoods: Lower Lawrenceville, Central Lawrenceville, Upper Lawrenceville, Bloomfield (WPRDC Neighborhoods layer, CC-BY)
important_notes: Counts are floors: search pagination under-delivers versus displayed counts (435 unique collected against a displayed 446 on the widened box).
The two platform counts may overlap and must never be added together; neither platform exposes addresses.
Rate figures are observed 2-night, 2-guest stay totals on stated dates, including per-stay fees; they are not nightly rates and are never averaged across windows.
Coordinates are platform-displaced by roughly 150 m; 63 of 273 live rows carry a material boundary-uncertainty flag.
star_rating is blank when a listing has no reviews; blank means not observed, never zero.
Nothing in this dataset is modeled or estimated.
Eight Airbnb rows are hotel-style rooms, not dwelling units; counts framed as housing exclude them.
